signals.evidence: There is no recent news or specific data in currentMetrics to confirm or deny this market share shift. My training data does not provide real-time market share for specific Chinese competitors.

signals.signal: EV and semiconductor factory capex cycle reverses — Cognex revenue declines >15% for two consecutive quarters
signals.evidence: Cognex's current revenue growth YoY is 24.3%, indicating a positive trend, not a decline. There is no recent news suggesting a reversal in capex cycles impacting Cognex's revenue negatively.

signals.signal: General-purpose vision foundation models commoditize industrial vision at <50% of Cognex cost
signals.evidence: There is no recent news or specific data in currentMetrics indicating that general-purpose vision foundation models are commoditizing industrial vision at a significantly lower cost, nor is there evidence of this impacting Cognex's pricing or market position.

assessment.keyWatchItem: Any announcements regarding new competitive offerings or pricing pressure in industrial machine vision.
